title: Lesson 22. Pictures and slide order
description: Little text, lots of pictures; inserting pictures, slide order and transitions

questions.prompt: What is a slide's main rule?
questions.explain: A slide is like a poster.

questions.prompt: You can reorder slides by dragging them on the left.
Match the word with its meaning
How do you shrink a slide picture without spoiling it?
Put in order how to add a picture to a slide
Which slides do we add in this lesson?
If you lack pictures, you can find and save them online.

learn.intro: Today the presentation comes alive: we add pictures, order and nice transitions!

slides.text: The main rule: **little text, lots of pictures**. A slide is like a poster: a big picture and a few words. You tell the details.

check.prompt: It is better to put lots of long text on a slide.

slides.text: The **Insert → Pictures** tab → your Pictures folder. A picture on every slide.
Shrink it by a **corner**, like in Word, and drag it to a free spot.

check.prompt: How do you put a picture on a slide?

slides.text: On the left are small slides — like a deck of cards. You can **drag** them to change the order.
**Transitions** are how slides appear. Pick a calm effect like "Fade": if everything spins and jumps, the audience watches the effect instead of listening to you.

options: A wild new one on each slide
check.explain: The audience should listen to you.
